<USER_REQUEST>
Fix the “Study Chapter” navigation and chapter resolution bug.

Currently, when a user expands a chapter card and clicks “Study Chapter”, the app navigates to the Study page but displays “Chapter not found.”

Expected behaviour

When the user clicks Study Chapter, open the study/content page for the exact chapter selected.

Example:
Physics → Units & Dimensions → Study Chapter
should open the Units & Dimensions study page/content, not a generic Study page and not “Chapter not found.”

Technical fix

* Audit the Study Chapter button’s onClick / navigation logic.
* Pass the correct canonical chapterId or chapter slug from the chapter card.
* Do not generate the route from the display name if the database uses a different slug/ID.
* On the Study Chapter page, resolve the chapter using the same canonical identifier used by the syllabus/database.
* Check for route-param mismatch, slug mismatch, casing, & vs and, spaces, hyphens, and URL encoding.
* Ensure Units & Dimensions and all other Physics chapters resolve correctly.
* Make this a global fix for every subject and chapter, not a hardcoded fix for Units & Dimensions.
* Preserve the selected subject context.

Routing expectation

Chapter Card → Study Chapter → Exact selected chapter's study content

Add a safe fallback only if the chapter genuinely does not exist. Do not show “Chapter not found” for valid chapters already present in the syllabus/database.

Do not redesign the UI. Fix only the chapter navigation, route mapping, and content resolution logic.

Before finishing, test the flow with at least Units & Dimensions, Motion in One Dimension, and one Chemistry/Mathematics chapter.
</USER_REQUEST>
